title: Communication cards for care work
description: Prepared everyday phrases for communication in care work, kept apart from medical decisions.

blocks.text: In everyday care, people sometimes find it hard to explain a simple request in another language. A mistake in information that matters calls for separate treatment.

quote.text: I needed to communicate to a Spanish speaking resident whom I care for(newly admitted ). 100% would never recommend this app.

blocks.text: Assemble everyday scenarios checked by language professionals, keep the original and let people confirm they have understood. Tell ordinary phrases apart from situations that call for a professional translator.
Do not promise that dosages, a diagnosis or consent to treatment can be conveyed safely by automatic translation. The limits of use have to be part of the scenario.
